description: Create comprehensive documentation (README.md with project overview, installation, usage examples, strategy catalog, algorithm catalog), examples directory with demo scripts, and final integration tests verifying the entire pipeline works end-to-end.
steps: Update README.md with: project description (democratizing quantitative finance), features overview, installation instructions, quick start guide, full strategy catalog table (100 strategies with category/name/description), full algorithm catalog table (100 algorithms with category/name/description), backtesting usage, portfolio construction usage, contributing guidelines, license info
Create docs/STRATEGIES.md - detailed documentation of all strategy categories with mathematical formulas and parameter descriptions
Create docs/ALGORITHMS.md - detailed documentation of all algorithm categories with mathematical foundations
Create docs/BACKTESTING.md - guide on using the backtesting engine with examples
Create docs/PORTFOLIO_CONSTRUCTION.md - guide on portfolio construction workflow
Create examples/momentum_backtest.py - backtest momentum strategies on sample data
Create examples/mean_reversion_pairs.py - pairs trading mean reversion example
Create examples/portfolio_optimization.py - compare multiple optimization algorithms
Create examples/multi_strategy_portfolio.py - combine multiple strategies into one portfolio
Create examples/risk_management.py - demonstrate risk management algorithms

Create tests/test_integration.py - end-to-end integration test: generate sample data -> apply 5 different strategies -> run backtest -> optimize with 5 different algorithms -> construct final portfolio -> verify metrics
Create CONTRIBUTING.md with guidelines for adding new strategies and algorithms
acceptance_criteria: README.md contains complete project documentation with all 100 strategies and 100 algorithms listed
All example scripts run without errors on sample/synthetic data
pytest tests/test_integration.py passes - full pipeline integration test works
CONTRIBUTING.md provides clear instructions for adding new strategies/algorithms
Documentation is well-formatted markdown suitable for GitHub rendering
